name: Hashimoto Reiko
source: Keigo's wife. Graduated from a prestigious university. Worked as a part-time model during college and later as a regional TV announcer – her beauty brought her a glamorous career. Consequently, she’s prideful and selfish. Life as a housewife seems utterly boring to her, and she constantly craves stimulation.
